release.changelog:
App Manager v4.1.1 improves permissions, installation, ADB connectivity, and several other parts of the application. Visit Settings > About > Version/Changelog for details.

**Revoke Internet Permission**
App Manager can now block internet for individual applications utilizing the eBPF rules in root or ADB mode. To block internet for an application, go to the "Uses permissions" tab and click on the toggle button next to `android.permission.INTERNET` to revoke the permission.
  
_Known Limitation._ The eBPF rules are lost after a reboot. App Manager attempts to restore the rules right after a reboot. However, in ADB mode, it might take a while to connect to wireless debugging depending on the availability of a Wi-Fi connection. This might allow applications that start after a reboot to use internet.  

**Others**
- Added support for editing `.bat` files  
- Improved installation reliability and performance  
- Improved permission management  
- Improved ADB pairing, connections, and mode handling  
- Improved settings transitions and startup messages  
- Fixed displaying profiles after creating a profile for the first time  
- Fixed intercepting browser URLs  
- Fixed listing applications on Android 17  
- Fixed title ordering in What's New dialog.  

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MuntashirAkon/AppManager/compare/v4.1.0...v4.1.1

release.changelog:
本次更新重点围绕模型兼容性、工具调用、聊天稳定性和数据管理展开，同时补充 ToolPkg、统计、恢复与性能监控能力。

## 增加

- 新增 Token 用量账本、统计看板、活动视图、价格覆盖、缓存命中率、生成速度和安全删除能力
- 新增独立 TTS/STT 服务档案，支持创建、复制、切换、删除和旧配置迁移
- 新增按窗口或指定日期范围重建聊天记忆
- Compose DSL 文件选择器新增文档、图片、视频、媒体、目录和相机模式
- 新增 `AiChat`、`AdaptiveSidePanel`、Compose DSL 对话框和聊天消息长按菜单
- 新增 DeepSeek Harness 运行时侧栏和完整 ToolPkg 运行时支持
- 新增 MiniMax、OpenCode Zen/Go、xAI Grok 和 OpenAI Codex OAuth 提供商，并支持 Codex 配额查询和 PDF 输入
- 新增按提供商和模型动态配置思考深度，补充 DeepSeek Responses、Qwen、Gemini 等端点规则
- 新增 DeepSeek Responses Web Search、服务端工具记录和 reasoning 回放
- ToolPkg 新增版本化 API、包依赖、加载顺序、运行态 Hook、消息持久化 Hook 和聊天消息菜单
- 新增数据库、DataStore 配置健康检查和手动修复流程，并在修复前归档原始文件
- 新增主进程、插件 QuickJS、终端和设备 CPU/内存/网络性能监控
- 新增日语本地化、xAI 绘图自定义 API 地址、ToolPkg Logo 和已选聊天记录导出

## 修复

- 修复并行或分段工具结果在流式展示、历史记录和下一轮请求中的顺序不一致问题
- 修复 Claude、DeepSeek、Gemini、Kimi、OpenAI 等 Provider 的工具调用与结果配对问题
- 修复未匹配工具结果被误报为“用户取消”，并补充缺失结果的诊断信息
- 修复 DeepSeek Responses commentary/reasoning 回放、工具历史和正文流式输出问题
- 修复 OpenAI Responses 中 `video_url`/`input_video` 内容丢失问题
- 修复长工具结果、超大聊天导出、被中断的流式回复和多工具结果被提前丢弃的问题
- 修复群聊编排重复发送用户消息，以及消息变体事件使用旧快照的问题
- 修复 Compose DSL 文本框光标跳动、复制预览回弹、输入法遮挡和 Markdown 表格链接点击问题
- 修复 MCP 工具发现成功后未及时注册，以及并发权限描述注册的数据竞争
- 修复媒体能力测试把“已连通”误判为“能力已验证”的问题
- 修复浏览器桌面 viewport、截图尺寸、Provider 历史图片和模型列表刷新问题
- 修复悬浮窗非法尺寸、初始化竞态和连续崩溃保护问题
- 修复 Web Chat JavaScript 模块 MIME 类型错误
- 修复备份恢复、SQLite 参数数量限制、偏好迁移和 ToolPkg manifest 解析问题
- 修复 OpenCode、Codex、DeepSeek 和 OpenAI 的思考参数映射与历史兼容问题

## 优化

- ToolPkg 发布、API 版本展示、依赖检查、包排序、manifest 选择和隐藏目录排除更加可靠
- 摘要支持分区配置、独立标题、启用状态和对话回顾设置
- Token 统计的迁移、恢复、重试、价格计算和长时间运行稳定性得到提升
- 状态卡片改用内置完整 Material Symbols 字体，离线环境下也能正常显示
- APK 逆向工具升级至 1.1.0，JADX 支持隔离进程、串行任务和更完整的错误诊断
- 改进聊天复制、长历史浏览、流式滚动、LaTeX 渲染和大消息处理

release.changelog:
What's new in 0.4.1912

- Download an area by framing it on the map, like Google Maps, at full street detail with the size shown as you go; the whole region around it is now a choice
- Offline maps can live on an SD card, and a downloaded region's map stays up on a connection with no real internet
- Downloaded regions update themselves on Wi-Fi by default, taking a small patch instead of a full download
- The route chooser minimizes to a one-line bar, drives can start north-up, and the navigation icon can be a car
- Walking directions come from the open router alone, without the detours Google's route added; picking a Google route no longer turns it into a loop
- Place pages get Overview, Reviews, Photos and Updates tabs, hold still while they load, and reviews load when you scroll to them, which cuts most of Vela's Google traffic
- Vela says when Google is giving it a limited view, Settings counts the requests sent to Google, and blocking Google's page telemetry is a setting
- Street-name bubbles stay until you pass them and then fade, and a parked drive no longer keeps the phone hot
- Dense cities stay smooth when zoomed in close
- Short Google Maps links open in Vela again
- Vela talks to Google as the current Chrome (155) on Chrome's own network stack
- Every language is caught up with English

Everything since 0.4.1733

- Route chooser minimizes to a one-line bar, sea names follow your language, list pins match place icons, road name no longer clipped in the bar
- Google's much shorter walk and unmatched Google drives get street names from the map instead of detours
- Walking directions come from the open router alone, without Google's route or the snap that added detours
- The nav trace export names the Vela build and device and lists why each route change happened
- Picking one of Google's routes no longer turns it into a loop or an out-and-back detour
- The map opens where you are instead of flying in, and a far jump in location moves the map at once
